theorems.name: Submission.codim1_lur_rectifiable_area_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (m d P : ℕ) (D B : Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid d → Euclid P) (Q : Euclid d → Submodule ℝ (Euclid d)), 1 ≤ m → IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G D → InjOn G D → (∀ v ∈ D, Injective (fderiv ℝ G v)) → MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ D → CountablyRectifiable m B → (∀ K : Set (Euclid d), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μHE[m] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ v ∂(μHE[m].restrict B), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m B v (Q v)) → CountablyRectifiable m (G '' B) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid d), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μHE[m] (G '' (B ∩ K)) ≠ ∞) ∧ ∃ J : Euclid d → ℝ, Measurable J ∧ (∀ v, 0 ≤ J v) ∧ (∀ᵐ v ∂(μHE[m].restrict B), ∀ σ : Fin m → Euclid d, Orthonormal ℝ σ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range σ) = Q v → J v = Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G v (σ i)) (fderiv ℝ G v (σ j))))) ∧ (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ w in G '' B, g w ∂μHE[m] = ∫⁻ v in B, ENNReal.ofReal (J v) * g (G v) ∂μHE[m]) ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ w in G '' B, f w ∂μHE[m] = ∫ v in B, J v * f (G v) ∂μHE[m]
